name: idevice
notes: Each device service is a Cargo feature; the repository adds C++ bindings, an FFI crate with C examples and an idevice-tools CLI whose xctest command can bridge WebDriverAgent HTTP and MJPEG ports to localhost. The README marks the API as unstable before 0.2.0. MIT license.
summary: A Rust library that talks to iOS device services over lockdownd, usbmuxd and RSD, with features for screenshots, SpringBoard control, app installation and launching WebDriverAgent runners.
